Hi Emily / Cannery events team,

Hope you're well — I'm coordinating a small leadership roundtable in Nashville (target date: Tue, Nov 18 evening) for ~18 senior product & procurement leaders from healthcare customers (Acme Health is a confirmed attendee). We're exploring venues that can provide a private dining room, AV for a short presentation, and a modest sponsor level (table + branding and two short sponsor remarks).

Can you please share:
- Sample sponsorship packages + pricing for an 18-person private dinner (food + non-alcoholic beverage, private server)
- Availability for Nov 18 (evening block 6:30–9:30pm) and an alternative date Nov 17/19 if 18th is unavailable
- Any minimum spend / room rental + whether you offer an exclusive NDA when handling customer lists
- Lead time for guaranteed headcount changes and payment schedule

I've attached a Redwood NDA (please review) — we typically ask venues to sign this before we share the guest list and sponsor details. If you prefer your standard venue agreement, please send it over for our legal team.

Attachments: NDA_Redwood-Cannery_20261012.pdf (NDA draft)

Looking to move quickly on this; can we get a ballpark by EOD Wednesday Oct 13?

Thanks —
Priya Natarajan
Field Marketing Lead, Events & Partnerships

Hi Priya — great to hear about the event, we'd love to host. Replying with initial info and a provisional quote.

Quick answers:
- Nov 18: provisional hold available (private dining room "The West Annex") — can seat up to 24. Alternate 17 or 19 are also open.
- Sample sponsorship package: private room + plated 3-course menu + server staff + basic AV (projector + mic) = $4,200. Sponsor table + two short remarks (up to 5 minutes each) included in a $1,000 sponsorship add-on. We can offer a 10% non-profit/partner discount on food if needed (not applicable to sponsor fee).
- Minimum spend / room rental: room is waived with minimum F&B spend of $3,600.
- Guarantee: final headcount due 7 days prior; payment 14 days prior for new customers, or Net 30 on account after reference checks.

I have attached our venue estimate and our short event SOW. Please review and let us know if you'd like a menu tasting. We can also sign your NDA — I've attached our standard venue agreement in case your legal team prefers that instead.

Attachments: Venue_Quote_Cannery_20261013.pdf, Event_SOW_v1.docx

We need to have a signed NDA or venue agreement before we provide the full guest list (we're strict on sharing other customers' names). If you want us to e-sign your NDA, please confirm the signatory and I'll issue a DocuSign.

Best,
Emily Cho
Senior Events Manager
